reviews.author: Sharon C.
reviews.text: Out of all of the insurance agents that I had the pleasure and this pleasure of dealing with. Mr. Javon King was extremely patient, informative and customer oriented towards me and my situation. I would truly without any hesitation recommend him to others that I know for their insurance and health insurance needs. I was extremely pleased his professionalism.
